program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to ambiguity-gated compositional prediction
question: Can the supported training-side ambiguity gate preserve its one-step benefit when probability mass is composed for two and three future transitions without increasing learned state capacity?
hypothesis: Use the sealed current-only relation rows and top-511 exact-pair rows. A transition from (previous,current) uses the exact-pair probability row only when the pair is dedicated, pair support is at least three, the current row has at least four training transitions, and its training-only top1-minus-top2 margin is at or below the frozen median; otherwise it uses the current-only probability row. Propagate pair-state probability mass for horizons two and three, retaining at most the top 512 pair states after each transition with deterministic mass/key tie-breaking and renormalization. Relative to the byte-identical first-order distributional baseline started from the same current motif, ambiguity-gated composition will improve pooled top-1 accuracy by at least 0.002 at both horizons, with no domain worse by more than 0.01.

distributional_parent_observation.diagnosis: Retaining probability mass fixed the greedy depth collapse, but first-order motif state remained context-ambiguous.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_relation: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair successor counts plus overflow
frozen_reuse.first_order_distributional_control: byte-identical normalized current-relation propagation with pooled-unigram fallback

composition.query_origin: heldout triple or longer window supplies observed previous and current motifs; no heldout outcome enters transition choice
composition.hybrid_transition: exact-pair normalized row iff frozen ambiguity/support gate passes; otherwise normalized current-only row; pooled training unigram only for zero rows
composition.beam_selection: after each transition, aggregate equal pair states, keep 512 highest probability masses with lexicographic pair tie-break, record retained mass, then renormalize

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and both horizon pooled gains, source nondegradation bounds, and beam-retained-mass threshold pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least one horizon has positive pooled gain over first-order distributional composition, but all supported thresholds do not pass.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither horizon improves over the first-order distributional baseline.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, gate, probability, beam, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
All learned relations, supports, ambiguity margins, and gate decisions are training-prefix only.
The runtime beam stores probability mass only and does not add learned parameters or persistent state.
The first-order distributional control is recomputed from the same training relation and queried from the same current motif.
All pruning is deterministic; duplicate complete probes are byte-identical.
Probability mass is checked before and after renormalization and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, exact-pair dictionary, support threshold, ambiguity rule, transition probabilities, runtime beam cap/tie-break, controls, horizons, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: feed the supported gated multi-step predictive state into bounded controlled reasoning without a tokenizer or model call

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute residual depth error to beam truncation versus context transition quality before adding state
